Title: vector DB.DBA.BAG_OR_NULL_AGG (
Description:
DB.DBA.BAG_OR_NULL_AGG returns a vector of passed values.
    Similar to DB.DBA.BAG_AGG() but returns NULL instead of an empty vector
    if no arguments were actually passed.
DB.DBA.BAG_OR_NULL_AGG
The order of items in the vector is not predefined and may vary from run to run.
